measurement: Filesystem stat after the two completed bounded real Hecate runs; logical bytes and allocated blocks are distinct
scope: The input, legacy and new directories only; the work directory's preregistration/result JSON files are excluded
output_scope: Output directory totals include logs, metadata, PNG/NPY files, and, for the new run, the component packet
allocation_method: Sum stat.st_blocks * 512 over regular files; filesystem-specific allocation, not a portable storage guarantee
